decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website and faces strong competition, so it is a weak option, but there is no evidence since 2019 that its value has failed, and keeping a listed dumper costs little.
The inclined furniture lift line has its own page and several models in a stable niche, and its low carrying cost justifies keeping the option open while demand evidence builds.
The building material lift line fits the firm's construction and lifting know-how and shares a platform with the furniture lifts, so it is cheap to keep and still promising.

The truck-mounted lift is a costlier, narrower variant whose value is still uncertain, but it complements the other lift lines, so management keeps it for now rather than abandoning it without negative evidence.
